explanation: Cubes with exactly 2 faces painted lie on the edges, excluding corners. A cube has 12 edges. Each edge has (n - 2) = (3 - 2) = 1 such cube. Total = 12 * 1 = 12.

Rectangle, Rhombus, and Regular Hexagon look identical after 180 degrees rotation (even order of rotational symmetry). Equilateral triangle has order 3 (120, 240, 360 degrees) and is not symmetric under 180 degrees.
